title: ZGCM-1：面向数学与智能体搜索的全开源高效基础模型
summary: ZGCM-1 是一个从零训练的全开源 7B 稠密基础模型，通过内部思考与外部工具调用结合突破参数容量限制，支持 256K 上下文。在数学推理与智能体搜索任务上可与 Qwen3-235B、GLM-5.1 等超大模型竞争，预训练效率提升约 4.2 倍，并开源权重、代码与数据配方。
summary_en: ZGCM-1 is a fully open 7B dense foundation model trained from scratch with extreme data, system, and algorithmic efficiency. Combining internal thinking with external tool use over a 256K context, it remains competitive with frontier models orders of magnitude larger on math reasoning and agentic search, achieving ~4.2x pre-training efficiency gains, with weights, code, and data recipes open-sourced.
